Role: Golang Backend Engineer
Requirements:
- B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science or Software Engineering
- Minimum 3 years of backend engineering experience
- Must have strong experience in Go, gRPC, Microservices, PostgreSQL, and Docker
- Deep understanding of concurrent programming and distributed systems
Preferred:
- Experience with Kubernetes, Redis, and Kafka is a plus
- Familiarity with CI/CD and Prometheus monitoring is desirable
